podcast.body: Sinéad O'Connor performed an a cappella cover of Bob Marley's "War" on *Saturday Night Live* on October 3, 1992. During the live performance, she tore up a picture of Pope John Paul II while singing the word "evil" as a protest against child abuse in the Catholic Church. "One of her songs was an acupel performance of a Bob Marley song called War."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
